[/url](づ￣ ³￣)づ Oiii! Fico muito feliz que você tenha gostado deste mod!
Ele é um pack de alteração de retratos já existentes do mod original, ou seja, alguém fez estas artes e eu modifiquei em cima delas, mantendo os traços, mas alterando o visual em si.
Então certifique-se de ter instalado o mod para que estas imagens funcionem certinho![/center]


[center]❤ ❤ ENCONTRANDO AS PASTAS ❤ ❤[/center][center]
- Abra sua pasta de mods (geralmente encontrada em: [u][i]SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i][/u])

- Para inserir o retrato, busque pela pasta:[b] [CP] 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/b]
-- Caso não tenha o mod original instalado, baixe ele e tudo que ele pede aqui: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url] 

- Para inserir o novo estilo do personagem, procure pela pasta: [b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters[/b]
-- Caso não tenha este mod instalado, baixe ele e tudo que ele pede aqui: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic
[/url][/center]


[center] ❤ FAZENDO A SUBSTITUIÇÃO DOS ARQUIVOS DE IMAGEM ❤ [/center]
[center]
Sim, para este mod funcionar é necessário você substituir as imagens já existentes dos mods originais, então eu recomendo você copiar todos os arquivos originais para uma pastinha separada, pare tê-los guardados caso queira voltar com o visual antigo, sem precisar baixar tudo de novo.[/center]
[center]
❤ RETRATO ❤ 

Abra a pasta [b][CP] 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits > assets > Portraits > Emily[/b],
e arraste ou cole/substitua todos os arquivos abaixo para esta pasta:
- Emily_Aerobics
- Emily_Fall
- Emily_Spring
- Emily_Summer
- Emily_Winter_Indoor
- Emily_Winter_Outdoor

Perfeito! Volte para a pasta [b]Portraits[/b] e vá para a pasta [b]Beach[/b],
nela você arraste ou cole/substitui o arquivo: 
- Emily_Beach

Volte novamente para a pasta Portraits e vá para a pasta Festivals, você verá que tem 2 pastas,
basta arrastar ou colar/substituir as devidas imagens para dentro das pastas corretas:
[b]Festivals > FlowerDance:[/b] - Emily_FlowerDance
[b]Festivals > SpiritsEve:[/b] - Emily_SpiritsEve[/center][center]

❤ VISUAL ❤

Abra a pasta [b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters > assets > Characters[/b],
e arraste ou cole/substitua o arquivo: Emily

Você vai fazer a mesma coisa nas outras pastas:
[b]Characters > Beach:[/b] - Emily_Beach
[b]Characters > Festivals > FlowerDance: [/b]- Emily_FlowerDance
[b]Characters > Festivals > SpiritsEve: [/b]- Emily_SpiritsEve

Prontinho! Você terminou, basta abrir o jogo e testar para ver se tudo está funcionando corretamente (^◡^ )

Qualquer dúvida pode me mandar uma mensagem na aba Posts ou abrir um tópico na aba de Bugs deste mod lá no Nexus. 
Muito obrigada e bom jogo! (◦'ںˉ◦)❤[/center]
[center][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/Y214KK2/linha-fw.png[/img][/url]

(づ￣ ³￣)づ Hey! I'm really glad you liked this mod!
It is a pack to change the existing portraits of the original mod, that is, someone made these arts and I modified them,
keeping the lines, but changing the look itself.
So make sure you have the mod installed for these images to work correctly!



❤ ❤ FINDING THE FOLDERS ❤ ❤

- Open your mods folder (usually found in: [i][u]SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/u][/i])

- To insert the portrait, search for the folder: [b][CP] 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/b]
-- If you don't have the original mod installed, download it here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits
[/url] 
- To insert the new character style, look for the folder: [b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters[/b]
-- If you don't have the original mod installed, download it here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic
[/url]


❤ ❤ ❤ ❤ REPLACING IMAGE FILES ❤ ❤ ❤ ❤

Yes, for this mod to work you need to replace the existing images of the original mod,
so I recommend you copy all the original files to a separate folder, to keep them in case you want to go back to the old look,
without having to download everything from scratch. new.



❤ PORTRAIT ❤ 

Open the folder [b][CP] 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits > assets > Portraits > Emily[/b],
and drag or paste/replace all the files below into this folder:
- Emily_Aerobics
- Emily_Fall
- Emily_Spring
- Emily_Summer
- Emily_Winter_Indoor
- Emily_Winter_Outdoor

Perfect! Go back to the [b]Portraits folder[/b] and go to the [b]Beach folder[/b], where you drag or paste/replace the file:
- Emily_Beach

Go back to the Portraits folder again and go to the Festivals folder, you will see that you have 2 folders,
just drag or paste/replace the appropriate images into the correct folders:
[b]Festivals > FlowerDance:[/b] - Emily_FlowerDance
[b]Festivals > SpiritsEve:[/b] - Emily_SpiritsEve


❤ VISUAL ❤

Open the folder [b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters > assets > Characters[/b],
and drag or paste/replace the file: Emily

You will do the same thing in the other folders:
[b]Characters > Beach:[/b] - Emily_Beach
[b]Characters > Festivals > FlowerDance:[/b] - Emily_FlowerDance
[b]Characters > Festivals > SpiritsEve:[/b] - Emily_SpiritsEve

Ready! You're done, just open the game and test to see if everything is working correctly (^◡^ )

Any questions can send me a message on the Posts tab or open a topic on the Bugs tab of this mod on Nexus.
Thank you very much and good game! (◦'ںˉ◦)❤[/center]
